sentences.text: Building a Text-Based Adventure Game with Gradio, LLaMA, and OLLAMA

sourceRef.title: Create a Text-Based Adventure Game with Llama

sentences.text: Developers have been using Large Language Models (LLMs) to develop text-based games since GPT-2, but it was difficult to set up.

sourceRef.title: Create a Text-Based Adventure Game with Llama

sentences.text: With Gradio, LLaMA 3, and OLLAMA, it is super easy to create a text-based game running locally on your own computer for free.

sourceRef.title: Create a Text-Based Adventure Game with Llama
